sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Bullshit is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I found myself a little rat in my own circle. Muppet was leaking info about my hideouts and supply routes. My lads put a bit of pressure on him and found out he'd been snitching to some gang. I want to feed them some fake intel about a shipment. They'll be waiting at the agreed spot and get thinned out a bit. Need you to slip the fake info in quietly, like you belong there, you get me? Take the flash drive and stash it near the lighthouse along with the AXMC sniper rifle and a Roler watch. That's the arrangement. Just make sure not to mess with any of the Rogues or their leaders, got it?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Stash an AXMC sniper rifle in the trash bags at the chalet tennis court on Lighthouse
- Stash a Roler Submariner gold wrist watch in the trash bags at the chalet tennis court on Lighthouse
- Stash a Military flash drive in the trash bags at the chalet tennis court on Lighthouse
- You must not kill any Rogues or The Goons while the task is active

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- +4 Stress resistance skill levels
- +4 Search skill levels
- Skier Rep +1.5
- 2,400 Euros
  - 2,520 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 2,760 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun
- 2× 12/70 flechette ammo pack (25 pcs)
- Unlocks barter for Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun at Skier LL4
"Seems like it went smoothly. My lads are already in position, so I reckon these idiots are in for a nasty surprise."

sections.heading: Failure Dialogue
sections.text: "What the fuck, you muppet?! Why'd you go and shoot at them? They won't let us within a mile of 'em now! How the bloody hell are we supposed to plant the fake intel, eh? Sod off!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle | 1 | Required | N/A | Stashed item |
| Roler Submariner gold wrist watch | 1 | Required | N/A | Stashed item |
| Military flash drive | 1 | Required | N/A | Stashed item |
In this quest you have to stash the 3 specified items in trash bags at the tennis court on Lighthouse. You must not kill any Rogues or The Goons while the task is active. It is possible to completely disassemble the AXMC rifle since it doesn't need to be functional to be stashed.
